cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Who Cares More?
cards.instruction: Turn every favor, memory, sacrifice, and affectionate gesture into evidence that you care more.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've kept twelve tickets from our trips. Submit your total before you claim you care as much as I do.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I kept mine in the album I made for you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The album is under my protection. I award myself the extra care required to preserve your gift.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Open it. I reinforced every page so your tickets could go in with mine.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Reinforcement approved. Put my tickets in too; I'll get a waterproof cover. You're providing memories, but I'm protecting both our collections.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 demands comparative totals, A3 awards self extra care for custody and A5 approves B reinforcement while claiming superior protection of both collections, using adjudicator status for the care contest.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 gifted album becomes A3 preservation credit; B4 reinforced pages causes A5 approval, insertion order and waterproofing claim.

relationship.evidence: B2 names a real affectionate gift and B4 thoughtful reinforcement, providing substantive caring evidence A appropriates.

heightening.evidence: B4 accommodation of A tickets makes A5 shared custody possible and supplies a new basis for claiming greater protective care.

specificity.evidence: A1 twelve tickets and B2 B tickets in album establish separate collections; A5 now explicitly directs insertion before the cover claim.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 B may supply memories while A safeguards them turns B thoughtfulness into A superior role, earned by B4 reinforced pages.
